mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT Y.STOCK_CODE, Y.STOCK_KO_NAME, Y.STOCK_MARKET, Y.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE, Y.DAILY_CLOSE_NUM, TO_CHAR(Y.DAILY_CLOSE_NUM) AS DAILY_CLOSE, TO_CHAR(Y.DIST20_NUM) AS DAILY_DIST20_PCT, TO_CHAR(Y.SCORE_NUM) AS RECO_SCORE, Y.RECO_SIGNAL_CODE, Y.RECO_SIGNAL_NAME, Y.RECO_TREND_TEXT, Y.RECO_REASON_DETAIL, TO_CHAR(Y.MODIFY_DATE_RAW, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS MODIFY_DATE, (CASE Y.RECO_SIGNAL_CODE WHEN 'STRONG_BUY' THEN 6 WHEN 'BUY' THEN 5 WHEN 'WEAK_BUY' THEN 4 WHEN 'HOLD' THEN 3 WHEN 'WEAK_SELL' THEN 2 WHEN 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RECO_RANK FROM ( SELECT X.*, (CASE WHEN X.SELL_BEAR = 1 THEN 'STRONG_SELL' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 80 THEN 'STRONG_BUY' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 65 THEN 'BUY' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 55 THEN 'WEAK_BUY' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 40 THEN 'HOLD' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 25 THEN 'WEAK_SELL' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 10 THEN 'SELL' ELSE 'STRONG_SELL' END) AS RECO_SIGNAL_CODE, (CASE WHEN X.SELL_BEAR = 1 THEN 'STRONG_SELL' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 80 THEN 'STRONG_BUY' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 65 THEN 'BUY' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 55 THEN 'WEAK_BUY' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 40 THEN 'HOLD' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 25 THEN 'WEAK_SELL' WHEN X.SCORE_NUM >= 10 THEN 'SELL' ELSE 'STRONG_SELL' END) AS RECO_SIGNAL_NAME, ('단기 ' || (CASE NVL(X.MACD_30M,'') WHEN 'BUY' THEN '반등' WHEN 'SELL' THEN '약세' ELSE '관망' END) || ' · 중기 ' || (CASE X.MON_DAILY WHEN 'UP' THEN '상승' WHEN 'DOWN' THEN '하락' ELSE '횡보' END) || ' · 장기 ' || (CASE X.SMA240_DAILY WHEN 'UP' THEN '우상향' WHEN 'DOWN' THEN '하락' ELSE '중립' END) ) AS RECO_TREND_TEXT, ('일봉정렬:'|| NVL(X.SMA_LINES_DAILY,'-') || ', 일봉MACD '|| NVL(X.MACD_DAILY,'-') || '(' || NVL(TO_CHAR(X.MACD_DAYS_DAILY),'-') || 'd)' || ', 30분MACD '|| NVL(X.MACD_30M,'-') || '(' || NVL(TO_CHAR(X.MACD_DAYS_30M),'-') || 'd)' || ', 20일이격 ' || TO_CHAR(X.DIST20_NUM, 'FM9990D00') || '%' || ', 거래량 ' || NVL(X.VOL_SIG_DAILY,'-') || '/' || NVL(X.VOL_SIG_30M,'-') || ', 컨센 ' || NVL(X.SALES_TREND,'-') || '/' || NVL(X.OP_TREND,'-') || '/' || NVL(X.EPS_TREND,'-') ) AS RECO_REASON_DETAIL FROM ( SELECT S.STOCK_CODE AS STOCK_CODE, S.STOCK_KO_NAME AS STOCK_KO_NAME, S.STOCK_MARKET AS STOCK_MARKET, S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE AS STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_CLOSE, ',', '')) AS DAILY_CLOSE_NUM, ROUND((TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_CLOSE, ',', '')) - TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, ',', ''))) / NULLIF(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, ',', '')),0) * 100, 2) AS DIST20_NUM, A.STOCK_SMA_LINES AS SMA_LINES_DAILY, A.STOCK_MON AS MON_DAILY, A.STOCK_SMA240 AS SMA240_DAILY, A.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL AS MACD_DAILY, NVL(TO_NUMBER(A.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS), 999) AS MACD_DAYS_DAILY, A.STOCK_AV_VOLUMESIGNAL AS VOL_SIG_DAILY, NVL(B.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL,'') AS MACD_30M, NVL(TO_NUMBER(B.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS), 999) AS MACD_DAYS_30M, NVL(B.STOCK_AV_VOLUMESIGNAL,'') AS VOL_SIG_30M, NVL(B.STOCK_MON,'') AS MON_30M, NVL(C.SALES_TREND,'') AS SALES_TREND, NVL(C.OP_TREND,'') AS OP_TREND, NVL(C.EPS_TREND,'') AS EPS_TREND, NVL(A.MODIFY_DATE, SYSDATE) AS MODIFY_DATE_RAW, /* 강한 약세 강제(안전장치) */ (CASE WHEN (A.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL = 'SELL' AND A.STOCK_MON = 'DOWN' AND INSTR(A.STOCK_SMA_LINES, '240,120,60,20,5') = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SELL_BEAR, /* 점수 계산(0~100) */ (CASE WHEN (A.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL = 'SELL' AND A.STOCK_MON = 'DOWN' AND INSTR(A.STOCK_SMA_LINES, '240,120,60,20,5') = 1) THEN 0 ELSE LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, /* 정배열/역배열 */ (CASE WHEN A.STOCK_SMA_LINES = '5,20,60,120,240' THEN 25 WHEN INSTR(A.STOCK_SMA_LINES, '5,20,60') = 1 THEN 18 WHEN INSTR(A.STOCK_SMA_LINES, '5,20') = 1 THEN 12 WHEN INSTR(A.STOCK_SMA_LINES, '240,120,60,20,5') = 1 THEN -15 WHEN INSTR(A.STOCK_SMA_LINES, '240,120,60') = 1 THEN -10 ELSE 0 END) /* 추세 */ + (CASE A.STOCK_MON WHEN 'UP' THEN 10 WHEN 'SAME' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE NVL(B.STOCK_MON,'') WHEN 'UP' THEN 4 WHEN 'SAME' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) /* MACD */ + (CASE WHEN A.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL = 'BUY' THEN GREATEST(5, 20 - LEAST(15, NVL(TO_NUMBER(A.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS), 15))) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN NVL(B.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL,'') = 'BUY' THEN GREATEST(3, 15 - LEAST(12, NVL(TO_NUMBER(B.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS), 12))) ELSE 0 END) /* 거래량 */ + (CASE WHEN A.STOCK_AV_VOLUMESIGNAL = 'UP' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN NVL(B.STOCK_AV_VOLUMESIGNAL,'') = 'UP' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) /* 장기 */ + (CASE A.STOCK_SMA240 WHEN 'UP' THEN 5 WHEN 'SAME' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) /* 20일 이격 */ + (CASE WHEN ROUND((TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_CLOSE, ',', '')) - TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, ',', ''))) / NULLIF(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, ',', '')),0) * 100, 2) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 8 WHEN ROUND((TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_CLOSE, ',', '')) - TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, ',', ''))) / NULLIF(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, ',', '')),0) * 100, 2) BETWEEN 5 AND 12 THEN 4 WHEN ROUND((TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_CLOSE, ',', '')) - TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, ',', ''))) / NULLIF(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, ',', '')),0) * 100, 2) BETWEEN -3 AND 0 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) /* 컨센 */ + (CASE NVL(C.SALES_TREND,'') WHEN 'UP' THEN 3 WHEN 'DOWN' THEN -2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE NVL(C.OP_TREND,'') WHEN 'UP' THEN 3 WHEN 'DOWN' THEN -2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE NVL(C.EPS_TREND,'') WHEN 'UP' THEN 3 WHEN 'DOWN' THEN -2 ELSE 0 END) )) END) AS SCORE_NUM FROM TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK S JOIN TB_S_STOCK_ANALYSIS A ON S.STOCK_CODE = A.STOCK_CODE AND A.USE_DIV = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_S_STOCK_30MINANALYSIS B ON S.STOCK_CODE = B.STOCK_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_S_STOCK_CONSENSUS C ON S.STOCK_CODE = C.STOCK_CODE AND NVL(C.USE_DIV,'Y') = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_DIV = 'Y' AND ( (#{market} = 'N' AND S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE = 'KR') OR (#{market} = 'A' AND S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE != 'KR') ) AND ( #{market} != 'N' OR #{domMarket} = 'ALL' OR (#{domMarket} = 'KOSPI' AND S.STOCK_MARKET = 'STK') OR (#{domMarket} = 'KOSDAQ' AND S.STOCK_MARKET = 'KSQ') ) ) X ) Y ) Z WHERE 1=1 AND Z.RECO_RANK = (CASE #{minGrade} WHEN 'STRONG_BUY' THEN 6 WHEN 'BUY' THEN 5 WHEN 'WEAK_BUY' THEN 4 WHEN 'HOLD' THEN 3 WHEN 'WEAK_SELL' THEN 2 WHEN 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
AND Z.DAILY_CLOSE_NUM >= TO_NUMBER(#{priceMin})
AND Z.DAILY_CLOSE_NUM <= TO_NUMBER(#{priceMax})
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(Z.RECO_SCORE) DESC, Z.MODIFY_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
